agentInstructions: FarFlappy is a Farcaster mini app — a skill-based flappy bird arcade game with on-chain tournaments on Base mainnet. Players tap/click to make the bird fly and dodge purple pipes. The game has 4 difficulty modes: Easy (slow, wide gaps), Medium (moderate), Expert (fast, narrow gaps), Insane (very fast, very narrow). Players earn $FLAPPY points each game and compete in weekly tournaments with USDC prize pools funded by ETH entry fees. To start: open the app at https://farflappy.xyz, connect a wallet (supports Farcaster/Warpcast wallet, MetaMask, Coinbase Wallet), choose a difficulty mode, then tap the screen or press spacebar to play. Tournament entry costs a small ETH fee on Base. Leaderboard and scores are stored on-chain.
